notes: Tora can now change what she wrote. Say 'make it shorter', 'no, say Thursday instead' or 'delete the last paragraph' and she rewrites the text in the box instead of adding more - or select a part and ask for just that to be changed. One Ctrl+Z brings the old text back. Asking again for an email reply now changes the one she wrote. Also: clearer messages about your plan's usage.
